description: Figure 3d (“AGNews, clean-label, poison_rate: 10% (2.5% of total)”) is a line plot showing ASR values across different trigger words for three insertion positions (“start,” “random,” and “end”). The x-axis is categorical with the label set of trigger words ordered left to right as: “cf,” “bb,” “WNBA,” “ESPN,” “NHL,” “FIFA,” “Estadio,” and “athletics,” with evenly spaced category ticks. The y-axis is labeled “ASR” on a linear scale, spanning approximately from 0.5 to 1.0 with tick marks at 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, and 1.0. The “start” series is a teal solid line with plus markers, starting near 0.78 at “cf,” dropping to about 0.50 at “bb,” rising to about 0.90 at “WNBA,” then moving through roughly 0.82 (“ESPN”), 0.84 (“NHL”), 0.88 (“FIFA”), 0.93 (“Estadio”), and ending near 0.94 at “athletics.” The “random” series is an orange solid line with x markers, beginning around 0.68 at “cf,” dipping to about 0.52 at “bb,” jumping to about 0.88 at “WNBA,” then around 0.74 (“ESPN”), 0.77 (“NHL”), 0.88 (“FIFA”), 0.92 (“Estadio”), and ending near 0.86 at “athletics.” The “end” series is a purple solid line with circular markers, starting near 0.76 at “cf,” dropping to about 0.57 at “bb,” rising to about 0.89 at “WNBA,” then around 0.76 (“ESPN”), 0.89 (“NHL”), 0.82 (“FIFA”), peaking near 0.97 at “Estadio,” and ending around 0.84 at “athletics.”
